morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，无马来语词缀；分为 a.fro 两个音节，保留 /fr/ 辅音组合。

senses.zh_definition: 阿弗罗发型：细密卷发向外蓬松展开、整体呈饱满圆形的发型。
senses.en_definition: A hairstyle in which tightly curled hair forms a full, rounded shape around the head.
senses.ms_definition: Potongan rambut berbentuk bulat dengan rambut yang keriting halus, tebal dan panjang.
senses.nuances: 指发型的形状与卷曲质地，不是所有卷发的统称，也不表示佩戴者必属某一族群。常置于 rambut、gaya rambut 或 potongan rambut 后。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=afro)

dual_scenarios.context: 文化新闻 / 展览介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran itu menampilkan potret pemuzik dengan gaya rambut afro yang popular pada tahun 1970-an.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览展出了音乐家留着二十世纪七十年代流行的阿弗罗发型的肖像。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition features portraits of musicians wearing the Afro hairstyle popular in the 1970s.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak cuba gaya rambut afro lah, tapi kena tanya pendandan dulu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hendak mencuba gaya rambut afro, tetapi perlu bertanya kepada pendandan rambut terlebih dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想试试阿弗罗发型啦，不过得先问问发型师。
dual_scenarios.en: I feel like trying an Afro, but I need to ask a hairstylist first.
spoken_features: nak 是 hendak 的口语形式
lah 增添随意、表达个人意愿的语气
aku 用于熟悉的平辈之间

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak cuba gaya rambut afro lah. Kau rasa sesuai tak?
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak mencuba gaya rambut afro. Adakah kamu rasa gaya itu sesuai untuk saya?
messages.zh: 我想试试阿弗罗发型啦。你觉得适合我吗？
messages.en: I'm thinking of trying an Afro. Do you think it would suit me?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tanya pendandan dulu lah, tengok sesuai tak dengan jenis rambut kau.
messages.ms_standard: Tanyalah pendandan rambut terlebih dahulu untuk mengetahui sama ada gaya itu sesuai dengan jenis rambut kamu.
messages.zh: 先问问发型师嘛，看看适不适合你的发质。
messages.en: Ask a hairstylist first and see whether it works with your hair type.

etymology.historical_story: The Afro carries a history beyond fashion. In the United States during the 1960s and 1970s, wearing natural, rounded curls became an expression of Black pride. Afro picks sometimes carried a raised-fist design, connecting everyday grooming with political identity. This cultural background helps explain why the hairstyle deserves respectful description rather than treatment as a comic costume. [Smithsonian history](https://nmaahc.si.edu/explore/stories/black-beautiful-emergence-black-culture-and-identity-60s-and-70s)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 a-fro，联想 Africa，再想象头发向四周蓬开成圆形：afro＝圆蓬卷发。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论他人的 afro 时，尊重其个人风格与文化身份；可称赞造型，避免拿发质或族群特征开玩笑。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合美发、时尚与文化介绍。描述发型不等于获得触摸别人头发的许可，触碰前应先征求同意。
